overview: This Senate resolution formally notifies the President that the Senate has elected Jennifer A. Hemingway as Sergeant at Arms and Doorkeeper of the Senate. The Sergeant at Arms is the Senate's chief law enforcement and security officer and manages many of its daily operations. Sending this kind of notice is a standard step when the Senate fills one of its top offices. The Senate approved it by unanimous consent on January 3, 2025.
for: Supporters say the notice keeps the executive branch properly informed about who holds key Senate offices.
against: Critics say the resolution is a routine formality that does not change any law or policy.
